heroHeadline: Rubin Camera Shut Down After Cooling Loss, Days After Return to Survey Operations
heroSubtitle: Rubin announced on Nov 9 that it was back in early LSST survey operations after the storm and planned maintenance, with engineering tests interleaved. On Nov 15 the pumped coolant system serving the LSST camera electronics lost cooling capacity; the camera was shut down and is reported safe while the team troubleshoots, with no return-to-sky date announced as of the Nov 17 status post.
